description: An App Router file convention that exports HTTP verb functions (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) built on standard Web Request and Response APIs.
In modern Next.js, GET Route Handlers execute dynamically on every request unless explicitly configured for static caching.
Reading the unparsed request body via request.text() to validate a cryptographic webhook signature before parsing JSON or mutating server state.
A next/cache API that marks tagged cache entries as stale using a cache life profile such as 'max' for background stale-while-revalidate refresh.
Scheduling secondary webhook audit logging inside after() so the external webhook provider receives an immediate 2xx acknowledgment.
